title: Autonomous Vehicle Heartbeat & Safety Fault Schema
description: ASN.1 schema encoding autonomous vehicle health heartbeats with ENUMERATED operating modes, BIT STRING subsystem fault flags, and tagged optional diagnostics.
code:
-- Autonomous Vehicle Health Heartbeat & Safety Fault Flags
AutonomyHealth DEFINITIONS EXPLICIT TAGS ::= BEGIN

DriveMode ::= ENUMERATED {
  manual(0),
  supervised(1),
  autonomous(2),
  minimalRiskManeuver(3),
  emergencyStop(4)
}

FaultFlags ::= BIT STRING {
  lidarDegraded(0),
  radarTimeout(1),
  gnssLost(2),
  brakeActuatorFault(3),
  steerActuatorFault(4),
  thermalDerating(5)
} (SIZE (8))

HeartbeatFrame ::= SEQUENCE {
  vehicleId     [0] IA5String (SIZE (4..16)),
  sequenceNum   [1] INTEGER (0..4294967295),
  mode          [2] DriveMode,
  faults        [3] FaultFlags,
  batteryPct    [4] INTEGER (0..100),
  note          [5] UTF8String (SIZE (1..64)) OPTIONAL
}

END
